_about: Hand-written corpus for ScamSignals (2026-09-19). Scam lines follow the common patterns described in public consumer-protection warnings (gift cards, code theft, 'Hi Mum' new number, fake delivery fees, fake bank/tax/toll, prize, crypto); none is a real message. Benign lines are the ordinary traffic a phone gets: codes, bank alerts, deliveries, family, appointments, marketing. The test requires 0 benign flagged; the scam hit rate is reported, not assumed.
